name: GitHub Agentic Workflows
desc: Write automations in Markdown; they compile to GitHub Actions YAML.
desc_zh: 用 Markdown 写自动化，它会编译成 GitHub Actions YAML。
solves: An Actions workflow cannot reason, so triage stays manual. These compile natural language into Actions, reusing the runner groups and policies you already have.
solves_zh: Actions 工作流不会推理，分诊就只能靠人。它把自然语言编译成 Actions，复用你现成的 runner 组和策略。
best_for: Issue triage, CI failure analysis or doc updates keep landing on a person.
best_for_zh: Issue 分诊、CI 失败分析或文档更新总是落到某个人头上。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — GitHub Changelog, https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-github-agentic-wo）。 Open-source project from GitHub Next. You can use GitHub Copilot or bring your own coding agent to power each workflow. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：首页不应是更新日志文章，改用 GitHub Next 的项目页；它随 GitHub Actions 正式发布，形态是 GitHub 内的功能面，不是自托管软件。 首次公开日期来源：https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-github-agentic-workflows-generally-available/
